reason: The database schema is unchanged. Since the installed release (2b21b86) no stored type changed. The changed types are request and reply types only: DriverControl.Continue and ExtensionDriver.Continue gained waiting, DriverReply gained Waiting, AttachedContext.workflow became ActiveWorkflow, SessionCommand and SessionReply gained Instructions, SessionReply.Workflow carries WorkflowReceipt and DispatchReply.Selection carries CohortOffer; the types that contain them (DriverRequest, DriverInput, Command, Result, ClientFrame, ServerFrame) are encoded only for HTTP, WebSocket, MCP, the local control socket and command output. The new types are reply projections (ActiveWorkflow, WorkflowInstructions, WorkflowReceipt, OfferedChoice, CohortOffer, WaitOutcome) and two files that only this release writes: SessionUnitEvent in units.jsonl of a session directory and AttachedHostRecord under hosts/ of a checkout's CQ directory; a session directory or checkout without them reads as having none. No codec of the PostgreSQL repositories, of the session-directory files or of project archives reaches a changed type, so existing data needs no transformation.
